summary: Hardcoded author Gemini API key in static HTML
details: The package contains a single index.html file that embeds a hardcoded Google Generative Language API key bound to the author's own Gemini account. There is no main entry, no require/import-time JavaScript, and no npm lifecycle scripts, so installing the package does not auto-execute the file or read any installer-side data. The exposed credential authenticates only against the author's own Gemini quota and project, so abuse of the key impacts the author, not installers. No installer environment variables, credentials, filesystem contents, or host identifiers are accessed or transmitted.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
